quote: The spectrum problem I: ℵε-saturated models, the main gap, Israel Journal of Mathematics vol. 43, 1982
note: Shelah introduced the main gap in his 1982 paper in Israel Journal of Mathematics. The work culminated years of research on classification theory, with foundational results published in his 1978 book 'Classification Theory'. The main gap is presented as a dichotomy theorem rather than a conjecture in Shelah's work.
